name: QuattroBox
description: QuattroBox is a fully 3D-printed lane-based MMU system inspired by the Filamentalist and BoxTurtle designs. It uses four modified Filamentalists, each with an independent extruder slightly inclined to optimize the filament path. The design requires no aluminum extrusions, making it entirely printable. It includes a filament enclosure for dust and humidity protection and offers multiple extruder options including BMG gear reduction variants with NEMA 17 or NEMA 14 steppers.
features: Three extruder options: BMG with NEMA 17, BMG with NEMA 14, or direct NEMA 17 pancake
Filament hub with optional Binky encoder for precise positioning
Filament enclosure protecting spools from dust and humidity
Status LEDs per lane and dedicated filament path illumination
LED strip on logo showing MMU status and active filament color
